items.title_zh: 专家：资金面扰动有限 流动性平稳跨月可期
items.body_zh: Wind数据显示，本周（11月23日—11月27日）央行公开市场有3795亿元隔夜逆回购到期，另有10000亿元MLF到期，两项合计13795亿元。受访专家普遍认为，临近跨月时点，央行将继续灵活运用各类公开市场操作工具，呵护流动性充裕，防范资金面出现较大波动。
items.title_en: Expert: Limited disruption on the funding front, stable liquidity expected to continue into the next month.
items.body_en: According to Wind data, this week (November 23–November 27), RMB 379.5 billion in overnight reverse share buybacks matured in the PBOC's open market, and an additional RMB 1 trillion in MLFs matured, totaling RMB 1.3795 trillion. The experts interviewed generally believe that as the end of the month approaches, the PBOC will continue to flexibly utilize various open market operation tools to maintain ample liquidity and prevent significant fluctuations in the money market.

items.title_zh: 资金面扰动有限 流动性平稳跨月可期
items.body_zh: ● 本报记者 彭扬 Wind数据显示，本周（11月23日—11月27日）央行公开市场有3795亿元隔夜逆回购到期，另有10000亿元MLF到期，两项合计13795亿元。
items.title_en: Limited disruption to liquidity; stable liquidity expected to continue into the next month.

items.title_zh: 交易员不再充分消化美联储12月加息的情景
items.body_zh: 标普500指数跌3.1%，纳斯达克100指数跌4.9%，纳指跌4.6%，半导体指数跌10%，Anthropic维持大约10%的跌幅。 英伟达跌11.79%，闪迪跌16%，博通跌12.58%，美光跌13.22%，英特尔跌6.13%，AMD跌13.59%，高通跌5.29%，台积电跌9.30%，阿斯麦跌6.70%。 VIX波动率日内涨幅达22.5%，报34.85。 美国2-7年期国债收益率至少跌15个基点。
items.title_en: Traders are no longer fully factoring in the scenario of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.
items.body_en: The S&P 500 Index fell by 3.1%, the Nasdaq 100 Index fell by 4.9%, the Nasdaq Composite Index fell by 4.6%, the Semiconductor Index fell by 10%, and Anthropic maintained a decline of approximately 10%. Nvidia fell 11.79%, SanDisk fell 16%, Broadcom fell 12.58%, Micron fell 13.22%, Intel fell 6.13%, AMD fell 13.59%, Qualcomm fell 5.29%, TSMC fell 9.30%, and ASML fell 6.70%. The VIX volatility index rose by 22.5% intraday, closing at 34.85. U.S. Treasury yields for 2- to 7-year maturities fell by at least 15 basis points.

items.title_zh: 回购增持密集落地，一年多次分红成常态，A股市场投融资生态加速转变
items.body_zh: 从大额分红承诺到密集回购增持，上市公司以“真金白银”回馈投资者的动作持续不断。权威数据显示：今年四季度以来，沪深上市公司共新增披露334单回购计划，预计回购金额上限超过700亿元，新增披露近1200单回购进展；新增控股股东、实际控制人、董事、高管增持计划109单，预计增持金额上限近200亿元，新增披露股东增持进展近300单。
items.title_en: Share buybacks are being implemented at an accelerated pace, and multiple dividend distributions within a year have become the norm. The investment and financing landscape of the A-share market is undergoing rapid transformation.
items.body_en: From substantial dividend commitments to intensive share buyback programs, listed companies continue to reward investors with "hard cash." According to authoritative data, since the fourth quarter of this year, listed companies on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges have disclosed a total of 334 new share buyback plans, with an estimated maximum buyback amount exceeding RMB 70 billion. Additionally, nearly 1,200 new share buyback progress updates have been disclosed. Furthermore, 109 new shareholding increase plans by controlling shareholders, actual controllers, directors, and executives have been announced, with an estimated maximum increase amount of nearly RMB 20 billion. Lastly, nearly 300 new shareholder shareholding increase progress updates have been disclosed.

items.title_zh: 强势美元“冲击波”再起
items.body_zh: 强势美元“冲击波”再起 ◎记者 黄冰玉 多重利好共振之下，美元汇率“水涨船高”。 本轮走强既体现了美联储加息预期的内生定价逻辑，也反映了AI资本开支热潮与美国经济韧性正吸...
items.title_en: The "shock wave" of a strong U.S. dollar strikes again.
items.body_en: The "shockwave" of a strong U.S. dollar is rising again ◎ Reporter Huang Bingyu Under the combined effect of multiple favorable factors, the U.S. dollar exchange rate is "rising with the tide." This round of strengthening not only reflects the endogenous pricing logic of the Federal Reserve's interest rate hike expectations, but also reflects the fact that the AI capital expenditure boom and the resilience of the U.S. economy are attracting...

items.title_zh: 欧洲股市创2025年以来最大周跌幅，科技股重挫
items.body_zh: 随着市场对人工智能（AI）热潮能否持续的疑虑再度升温，从股票到铜等全球资产均受到冲击，欧洲股市录得2025年4月以来最大单周跌幅。 斯托克欧洲600指数收盘下跌2%，本周累计跌幅扩大至5.8%。科技分类指数本周重挫11%，创2020年3月以来最大单周跌幅。随着铜和黄金价格下跌，矿业股也走低。 投资者转而买入个人护理、食品和医疗保健等更具防御性的板块。
items.title_en: European stock markets experience their largest weekly decline since 2025, with tech stocks taking a significant hit.
items.body_en: As market doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom resurface, global assets ranging from stocks to copper have been impacted, with European stock markets recording their largest weekly decline since April 2025. The STOXX Europe 600 Index closed down 2%, bringing its cumulative decline for the week to 5.8%. The technology sector index plummeted by 11% this week, marking its largest weekly decline since March 2020. As copper and gold prices fell, mining stocks also declined. Investors have shifted to buying more defensive sectors such as personal care, food, and healthcare.

items.title_zh: 欧盟与印尼签署贸易和投资协定
items.body_zh: 欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩称，欧盟与印度尼西亚（印尼）签署了综合性经济合作伙伴协议与投资保护协议，以期促进贸易与投资。 欧盟委员会在一份新闻稿中表示，协议取消了欧盟商品出口到印尼的98.5%税目项下的进口关税。这两项协议现在都需要欧洲议会的批准。 印尼当局也在进行其内部的批准程序。
items.title_en: EU and Indonesia Sign Trade and Investment Agreement.
items.body_en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that the European Union (EU) and Indonesia have signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement and an Investment Protection Agreement with the aim of promoting trade and investment. In a press release, the European Commission stated that the agreement eliminates import tariffs on 98.5% of tariff lines for EU goods exported to Indonesia. Both agreements now require approval from the European Parliament. The Indonesian authorities are also undergoing their internal approval process.

items.title_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnific
items.body_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnificent 7）指数跌5.01%，报194.71点，本周累计下跌10.28%，11月16-18日维持小幅下跌，19日（Anthropic美国IPO首日）以来持续扩大跌幅。 英伟达收盘重挫14%，创2025年1月份以来最大单日跌幅；本周重挫23%，创2008年10月份以来最大单周跌幅。
items.title_en: Closing Report on the U.S. Magnificent Seven Stocks | On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent Seven tech stocks.
items.body_en: U.S. Magnificent 7 Closing Report｜On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent 7 tech stocks index fell 5.01% to 194.71 points, with a cumulative decline of 10.28% this week. It remained slightly down from November 16–18 and has continued to widen its decline since November 19 (the first day of Anthropic's U.S. IPO). Nvidia closed down 14%, marking its largest single-day decline since January 2025. It fell 23% this week, its biggest weekly drop since October 2008.

items.title_zh: 报道：AI服务器厂商涨价幅度最高达45%
items.body_zh: 据媒体报道，戴尔、慧与科技（HPE）、联想和超微电脑正在要求提高AI服务器的价格，涨幅最高达45%，即使是几个月前已签署的协议也不例外。这些更高的成本正在影响交易公司及其他客户。
items.title_en: Report: AI server manufacturers raise prices by up to 45%.
items.body_en: According to media reports, Dell, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), Lenovo, and Supermicro are seeking to raise the prices of AI servers by up to 45%, even for agreements signed several months ago. These higher costs are affecting trading firms and other customers.

items.title_zh: 马斯克：AI行业明年可能面临严重的资金短缺
items.body_zh: 马斯克回应知名深度学习领域开源项目Keras创始人弗朗索瓦·肖莱（François Chollet）并表示，让如此大规模的算力设备通电、冷却并实现稳定运行，极其困难。人工智能行业明年可能面临严重的资金短缺。如果全行业从支付算力成本到设备能够稳定创收的时间累计推迟数月，仅营运资金就可能需要额外投入数千亿美元，马斯克反问这些资金将从何而来。
items.title_en: Elon Musk: The AI industry may face a severe funding shortage next year.
items.body_en: Musk responded to François Chollet, founder of the well-known open-source project Keras in the field of deep learning, stating that it is extremely difficult to power, cool, and stably operate computing equipment on such a large scale. The AI industry may face a severe funding shortfall next year. If the entire industry experiences a cumulative delay of several months, from paying for computing power costs to the time when equipment can generate stable revenue, working capital alone could require an additional investment of hundreds of billions of dollars. Musk questioned where these funds would come from.

items.title_zh: 融资保证金比例下限降至80%，有望释放4000亿元增量资金
items.body_zh: 11月22日，经中国证监会批准，沪深北交易所发布《关于调整融资保证金比例等相关安排的通知》，将融资保证金比例下限从100%降低至80%。据业内测算，融资保证金比例下限降至80%，有助于降低新增资金开仓成本、盘活融资合约存量资金，有望释放4000亿元增量资金。（上证报）
items.title_en: The lower limit of the margin requirement for margin trading has been reduced to 80%, which is expected to release an additional RMB 400 billion in funds.
items.body_en: On November 22, with the approval of the CSRC, the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing Stock Exchanges issued the "Notice on Adjusting the Margin Ratio for Financing and Other Related Arrangements," reducing the lower limit of the margin ratio for financing from 100% to 80%. According to industry estimates, lowering the minimum margin ratio for financing to 80% helps reduce the cost of opening new positions with additional funds and activates existing funds in financing contracts, potentially releasing RMB 400 billion in incremental capital. (Shanghai Securities News).

items.title_zh: 商务部新闻发言人就美国联邦通信委员会拟禁止中国电信运营商直接获取美国互联网电话号码资源答记者问
items.body_zh: 问：美东时间11月19日，美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）投票通过有关规则，拟禁止中国电信、中国联通、中国移动等被列入“覆盖清单”的电信运营商直接获取美国互联网电话号码资源。请问商务部对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。美国联邦通信委员会滥用监管权力，泛化所谓国家安全风险，在缺乏事实依据的情况下，违反非歧视和公平竞争原则，肆意污蔑、恶意打压中国电信企业在美运营。
items.title_en: The Ministry of Commerce Spokesperson Answers Reporters' Questions Regarding the U.S. Federal Communications Commission's Proposed Ban on Chinese Telecom Operators Directly Obtaining U.S. Internet Phone Number Resources.
items.body_en: Q: On November 19, U.S. Eastern Time, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) voted to adopt rules that would prohibit telecommunications operators such as China Telecom, China Unicom, and China Mobile, which are included on the "Covered List," from directly obtaining U.S. Internet telephone number resources. What is the Ministry of Commerce's comment on this? Answer: We have taken note of the relevant situation. The U.S. Federal Communications Commission has abused its regulatory authority and generalized the so-called national security risks. Without any factual basis, it has violated the principles of non-discrimination and fair competition, wantonly slandering and maliciously suppressing the operations of Chinese telecommunications companies in the United States.

items.title_zh: 深交所就创业板做市交易业务相关规则公开征求意见
items.body_zh: 本次征求意见的《做市业务细则》，对创业板股票做市交易业务进行管理。一是明确做市服务申请备案要求。经中国证监会核准取得上市证券做市交易业务资格的证券公司，以备案方式向深交所申请为创业板股票提供做市服务。二是明确做市商权利与义务。做市商应通过做市专用证券账户开展做市交易业务。深交所定期对做市商做市服务进行评价，激励做市商积极履行做市义务。三是明确对做市商的监督管理要求。
items.title_en: The Shenzhen Stock Exchange Seeks Public Comments on Rules Related to Market-Making Trading on the ChiNext Market.
items.body_en: The "Detailed Rules for Market Making Business" for which comments are being solicited this time govern the market making trading business for ChiNext stocks. First, the requirements for applying for the filing of market-making services are clarified. Securities companies that have been approved by the CSRC to qualify for listed securities market making trading business shall apply to the SZSE for providing market making services for ChiNext stocks by filing. Second, the rights and obligations of market makers are clarified. Market makers shall conduct market-making trading business through dedicated market-making securities accounts. The SZSE regularly evaluates market makers' market-making services to incentivize them to actively fulfill their market-making obligations. Third, clarify the supervisory and regulatory requirements for market makers.

items.title_zh: 两年期美债收益率周五跌超10个基点，本周累跌超19个基点
items.body_zh: 周五（11月20日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率下跌10.24个基点，报4.9438%，连续五个交易日回撤，本周累计下跌19.14个基点，交投于5.1494%-4.9039%区间，11月16-19日平缓地持续走低、19日（Anthropic美国IPO首日）美股开盘以来加速下跌。
items.title_en: The yield on two-year U.S. Treasury bonds fell by more than 10 basis points on Friday, with a cumulative decline of over 19 basis points this week.
items.body_en: At the close of trading in New York on Friday (November 20), the U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury yields fell by 10.24 basis points to 4.9438%, marking a decline for five consecutive trading days. Over the week, they fell by a cumulative 19.14 basis points, trading within the range of 5.1494%–4.9039%. They steadily declined from November 16–19 and accelerated their decline since the opening of U.S. equities on November 19 (the first day of Anthropic's U.S. IPO).

items.title_zh: 世界首套静止全功率发生器投运
items.body_zh: 11月20日，由国家电网有限公司自主研制的世界首套35千伏/30兆伏安IGBT串联型静止全功率发生器，经过短路试验后168小时试运行，在陕西延安330千伏方河变电站正式投运，标志着我国在大电网稳定支撑技术与高端电力电子装备自主研制领域取得重要突破。（科技日报）
items.title_en: The world's first stationary full-power generator is put into operation.
items.body_en: On November 20, the world's first 35 kV/30 MVA IGBT series static full-power generator, independently developed by State Grid Corporation of China, was officially put into operation at the 330 kV Fanghe Substation in Yan'an, Shaanxi, after 168 hours of trial operation following a short-circuit test. This marks a significant breakthrough for China in the fields of large power grid stability support technology and the independent development of high-end power electronic equipment. (Science and Technology Daily).

items.title_zh: 报道：美国民主党将寻求推翻特朗普的税收和关税政策
items.body_zh: 美国民主党将在明年掌控美国国会后举行听证会，研究如何撤销特朗普经济政策中的关键内容，包括关税和税收政策。众议院负责贸易和税收事务的民主党最高级别议员理查德·尼尔表示，他计划对特朗普实施的各项关税政策展开全面调查。尼尔表示，他还将审查特朗普政府推出的税收优惠政策，包括加剧美国财政赤字的大规模减税措施，并将恢复数百万美国人享有的政府医疗补贴列为优先事项。
items.title_en: Report: U.S. Democrats to Seek Overturn of Trump's Tax and Tariff Policies.
items.body_en: After taking control of the U.S. Congress next year, the Democratic Party will hold hearings to study how to reverse key elements of Trump's economic policies, including tariffs and tax policies. Richard Neal, the highest-ranking Democratic member of the House of Representatives responsible for trade and tax matters, stated that he plans to conduct a comprehensive investigation into the various tariff policies implemented by Trump. Neal also stated that he will review the tax incentives introduced by the Trump administration, including the large-scale tax cuts that have exacerbated the U.S. budget deficit, and will prioritize the restoration of government healthcare subsidies enjoyed by millions of Americans.

story.era: 欧洲 · 布达佩斯投机家
story.title_zh: 经济和股市，是主人和狗
story.title_en: The Economy and the Dog on a Leash
story.body_zh: 科斯托拉尼有个流传最广的比喻：经济是主人，股市是狗。狗前后乱跑，但拴着绳，最终都会跟着主人回家。他从不因股市涨跌过度兴奋或恐慌，只盯着绳子另一头。他的忠告：有耐心的人才会赢。
story.body_en: André Kostolany left behind his most famous picture. The economy is the owner. The stock market is the dog. The dog runs ahead, then falls behind. But the leash connects them, and both arrive home together. Patience wins. Money alone does not.

lines.en: A park in Europe. An old speculator is walking a big restless dog, and a young admirer is walking beside him.
lines.zh: 欧洲某公园。一个老投机家牵着一只躁动的大狗散步，身边跟着个仰慕他的年轻人。

lines.en: Monsieur, the market ran up three percent this week, then fell back two. What should I do?
lines.zh: 先生，这周股市涨了百分之三，又跌回去两个点。我该怎么办？

lines.en: Look at my dog. He runs ahead of me, then falls behind. Up and down, back and forth.
lines.zh: 看我的狗。他一会儿冲到我前面，一会儿又落在后面。上蹿下跳，来回折腾。

lines.en: But he always ends up where you end up?
lines.zh: 但最后他都跟着您走到同一个地方？

lines.en: Exactly. The economy is the owner. The market is the dog. Watch the far end of the leash, not the dog.
lines.zh: 正是。经济是主人，股市是狗。盯住绳子另一头的主人，别盯狗。

lines.en: After seventy years in markets, his advice was simple. Patience wins. Money alone does not.
lines.zh: 在股海浮沉七十年后，他的忠告只有一句：有耐心的人才会赢，光有钱不行。

joke.title_zh: 爱因斯坦说复利是第八大奇迹？
joke.title_en: Did Einstein Call Compounding the Eighth Wonder?
joke.body_zh: 据说爱因斯坦讲过：复利是世界第八大奇迹，懂的人赚它，不懂的人付它。这句话他大概率没说过，却成了金融圈流传最广的名言。真假不重要，道理是真的：时间+利率，是普通人和财富之间最诚实的一条路。反过来也一样，利滚利的债，也会按同样的数学惩罚不守纪律的人。
joke.body_en: People say Einstein once called compound interest the eighth wonder of the world. Those who understand it earn it. Those who do not, pay it. He probably never said it. But the quote refuses to die, because the math is real. Time, plus a steady rate, is the most honest road to wealth for ordinary people. And the road works both ways. Debt compounds too, with the same mathematics, punishing those who break their rules.

items.title_zh: 交易员不再充分消化美联储12月加息的情景
items.body_zh: 标普500指数跌3.1%，纳斯达克100指数跌4.9%，纳指跌4.6%，半导体指数跌10%，Anthropic维持大约10%的跌幅。 英伟达跌11.79%，闪迪跌16%，博通跌12.58%，美光跌13.22%，英特尔跌6.13%，AMD跌13.59%，高通跌5.29%，台积电跌9.30%，阿斯麦跌6.70%。 VIX波动率日内涨幅达22.5%，报34.85。 美国2-7年期国债收益率至少跌15个基点。

items.title_zh: 欧洲股市创2025年以来最大周跌幅，科技股重挫
items.body_zh: 随着市场对人工智能（AI）热潮能否持续的疑虑再度升温，从股票到铜等全球资产均受到冲击，欧洲股市录得2025年4月以来最大单周跌幅。 斯托克欧洲600指数收盘下跌2%，本周累计跌幅扩大至5.8%。科技分类指数本周重挫11%，创2020年3月以来最大单周跌幅。随着铜和黄金价格下跌，矿业股也走低。 投资者转而买入个人护理、食品和医疗保健等更具防御性的板块。
items.title_en: European stock markets experience their largest weekly decline since 2025, with tech stocks taking a significant hit.
items.body_en: As market doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom resurface, global assets ranging from stocks to copper have been impacted, with European stock markets recording their largest weekly decline since April 2025. The STOXX Europe 600 Index closed down 2%, bringing its cumulative decline for the week to 5.8%. The technology sector index plummeted by 11% this week, marking its largest weekly decline since March 2020. As copper and gold prices fell, mining stocks also declined. Investors have shifted to buying more defensive sectors such as personal care, food, and healthcare.

items.title_zh: 普兰特莫兰金融顾问公司（Plante Moran Financial Adv
items.body_zh: 普兰特莫兰金融顾问公司（Plante Moran Financial Advisors）首席投资官Jim Baird：市场原本希望Anthropic的IPO能带来持续提振，但其股价走势反映出外界对AI领域更广泛的担忧。 Anthropic上市之际，正值市场对该行业普遍持怀疑态度之时，人们对其能否在短期内兑现日益高企的预期存在诸多疑问。
items.title_en: Plante Moran Financial Advisors.
items.body_en: Jim Baird, Chief Investment Officer at Plante Moran Financial Advisors: The market had hoped that Anthropic's IPO would provide a sustained boost, but its share price performance reflects broader concerns about the AI sector. Anthropic's IPO comes at a time when the market is generally skeptical of the industry, with many questions about whether it can meet increasingly high expectations in the short term.

items.title_zh: 彭博经济研究（Bloomberg Economics）经济学家Anna Wong
items.body_zh: Anthropic的这笔（美国IPO）交易可能标志着AI交易热潮的终结。 该公司的财务数据显示前沿智能领域的定价能力正在减弱，这意味着即便市场对AI服务存在巨大需求，领先的提供商也很难让客户支付足够高的费用，以证明其巨额支出的合理性。
items.title_en: Anna Wong, Economist at Bloomberg Economics.
items.body_en: Anthropic's (U.S. IPO) deal may mark the end of the AI dealmaking boom. The company's financial data shows that pricing power in the cutting-edge AI sector is weakening, meaning that even with strong market demand for AI services, leading providers are struggling to charge customers enough to justify their substantial expenditures.

items.title_zh: 欧盟与印尼签署贸易和投资协定
items.body_zh: 欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩称，欧盟与印度尼西亚（印尼）签署了综合性经济合作伙伴协议与投资保护协议，以期促进贸易与投资。 欧盟委员会在一份新闻稿中表示，协议取消了欧盟商品出口到印尼的98.5%税目项下的进口关税。这两项协议现在都需要欧洲议会的批准。 印尼当局也在进行其内部的批准程序。
items.title_en: EU and Indonesia Sign Trade and Investment Agreement.
items.body_en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that the European Union (EU) and Indonesia have signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement and an Investment Protection Agreement with the aim of promoting trade and investment. In a press release, the European Commission stated that the agreement eliminates import tariffs on 98.5% of tariff lines for EU goods exported to Indonesia. Both agreements now require approval from the European Parliament. The Indonesian authorities are also undergoing their internal approval process.

items.title_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnific
items.body_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnificent 7）指数跌5.01%，报194.71点，本周累计下跌10.28%，11月16-18日维持小幅下跌，19日（Anthropic美国IPO首日）以来持续扩大跌幅。 英伟达收盘重挫14%，创2025年1月份以来最大单日跌幅；本周重挫23%，创2008年10月份以来最大单周跌幅。
items.title_en: Closing Report on the U.S. Magnificent Seven Stocks | On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent Seven tech stocks.
items.body_en: U.S. Magnificent 7 Closing Report｜On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent 7 tech stocks index fell 5.01% to 194.71 points, with a cumulative decline of 10.28% this week. It remained slightly down from November 16–18 and has continued to widen its decline since November 19 (the first day of Anthropic's U.S. IPO). Nvidia closed down 14%, marking its largest single-day decline since January 2025. It fell 23% this week, its biggest weekly drop since October 2008.

During a Q&A session with reporters on Saturday, Zelensky named current Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha...

items.title_zh: MSCI新兴市场股票指数跌入熊市，AI引发全球抛售
items.body_zh: 11月20日，MSCI新兴市场股票指数跌入熊市，七连跌创2024年以来最长连跌纪录，全球科技股遭遇抛售。明晟公司MSCI新兴市场股票指数跌3.1%，较6月峰值累计回撤21%；单周跌幅创2020年3月以来最大，随着Anthropic PBC上市不久下跌，加上英伟达再曝丑闻，对人工智能（AI）交易的疑虑演变成全面抛售。 MSCI发展中国家外汇指数跌0.05%。
items.title_en: MSCI Emerging Markets Equity Index enters bear market, AI triggers global sell-off.
items.body_en: On November 20, the MSCI Emerging Markets Equity Index entered a bear market, with seven consecutive declines marking the longest streak of declines since 2024, as global tech stocks faced a sell-off. The MSCI Emerging Markets Equity Index fell by 3.1%, representing a cumulative drawdown of 21% from its June peak. This marked the largest weekly decline since March 2020. As Anthropic PBC experienced a decline shortly after its IPO, coupled with another scandal involving Nvidia, concerns about artificial intelligence (AI) trades escalated into a widespread sell-off. The MSCI Emerging Markets Currency Index fell by 0.05%.

items.title_zh: 科技股抛售搅动市场，AI信用风险指标恶化，谷歌CDS创历史新高
items.body_zh: 由于人工智能（AI）交易的动摇引发全球市场波动，周五，部分最大规模超大规模云厂商（hyperscalers）和芯片制造商的信用风险指标攀升，同时其债券价格走弱。 根据ICE数据服务（ICE Data Services）的数据，为甲骨文公司债务提供五年期违约保护的成本最多攀升4.2个基点，达到327.9个基点，创10月20日以来最高水平。
items.title_en: Tech stock sell-off shakes up the market, AI credit risk indicators worsen, and Google CDS hits an all-time high.
items.body_en: On Friday, credit risk indicators for some of the largest hyperscalers and chip manufacturers rose, while their bond prices weakened, as fluctuations in artificial intelligence (AI) trading triggered volatility in global markets. According to ICE Data Services, the cost of five-year default protection on Oracle's debt rose by up to 4.2 basis points to 327.9 basis points, the highest level since October 20.

items.title_en: Lan Fo'an Attends the Signing Ceremony for the Agreement on the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank Hong Kong Office.
items.body_en: On November 21, the signing ceremony for the agreement establishing the Hong Kong office of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) was held in Hong Kong. Minister of Finance Lan Fo'an attended the ceremony and, on behalf of the Chinese government, co-signed the agreement with AIIB President Jin Liqun. Over the week, they fell by a cumulative 19.14 basis points, trading within the range of 5.1494%–4.9039%. items.title_zh: 随着AI市场持续暴跌，铜价或将录得19个月来最大单周跌幅
items.body_zh: 受人工智能（AI）领域投资热情持续减弱影响，周五铜价暴跌至3月以来最低点，并有望创下逾19个月来最大单周跌幅。截至17:01 GMT， 伦敦金属交易所（LME）基准三个月期铜价格下跌3%，报每公吨12,150美元。 此前，该价格一度 触及12,020美元，创下自3月24日以来的新低。这种被认为将在人工智能基础设施建设中发挥巨大作用的金属，本周已下跌约9.3%，恐将创2025年4月4日当周以来最大的单周跌幅。
items.title_en: As the AI market continues to plummet, copper prices may record their largest weekly decline in 19 months.
items.body_en: Due to the continued waning of investment enthusiasm in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), copper prices plummeted to their lowest level since March on Friday and are expected to record their largest weekly decline in over 19 months. As of 17:01 GMT, the London Metal Exchange (LME) benchmark three-month copper price fell by 3% to $12,150 per metric ton. Earlier, the price had briefly touched $12,020, marking its lowest level since March 24. This metal, which is expected to play a significant role in the construction of AI infrastructure, has fallen by about 9.3% this week and is likely to record its largest weekly decline since the week of April 4, 2024.

items.body_zh: 过去一直很难真正摸清AI需求的底细，而Anthropic正是这个问题的答案。 我们将更清楚地了解AI在需求和回报方面的上行空间，与此同时，我们也将更加深刻地认识到这项业务烧钱有多么疯狂、成本有多么高昂。

items.body_en: In the past, it has always been difficult to truly understand the details of AI demand, and Anthropic is the answer to this question. We will gain a clearer understanding of the upside potential of AI in terms of demand and returns. At the same time, we will also develop a deeper appreciation of just how wildly cash-intensive and costly this business is.

The draft prospectus shows that, after deducting issuance expenses, the funds raised from this corporate bond offering are intended for productive expenditures, specifically including the repayment of maturing debts, replenishment of working capital, project construction and operation, equity acquisitions, and other uses permitted by applicable laws, regulations, and/or regulatory authorities. items.title_zh: 知网升级AIGC检测算法后，AI疑似检出率出现大幅波动
items.body_zh: 记者梳理发现，目前，各个提供AIGC检测功能的平台，收费模式各不相同，有的按篇收费，有的按字数计费，以知网个人版为例，AIGC检测按字符计费，单价2元每千字符，不足千字符按千字符计算，检测给学生们带来经济负担的同时，还有检测结果差异所带来的困扰。 可查公开报道显示，知网近期完成模型升级之后，不少使用者反馈，文稿内容没有改动，复测的AI疑似率却大幅上涨，部分人工撰写的文本，甚至项目名称、作者姓名都出现被误标红的情况。
items.title_en: After CNKI upgraded its AIGC detection algorithm, the suspected AI detection rate fluctuated significantly.
items.body_en: Upon investigation, the reporter found that currently, platforms offering AIGC detection services have varying fee structures. Some charge per article, while others charge based on word count. For instance, CNKI's personal version charges for AIGC detection on a per-character basis, with a unit price of 2 yuan per thousand characters. If the text is less than a thousand characters, it is still charged as a thousand characters. This not only places a financial burden on students but also causes confusion due to discrepancies in detection results. According to publicly available reports, after CNKI recently completed a model upgrade, many users reported that although the content of their manuscripts had not changed, the AI suspicion rate from re-testing had increased significantly. In some cases, text written by humans, and even project names and authors' names, were incorrectly highlighted in red.

story.title_zh: 口红卖得越好，经济可能越差
story.body_zh: 林奇管麦哲伦基金时发现：经济越不景气，口红反而卖得越好。钱紧的时候，女人买不起新衣服，就买支口红让自己开心一下。机会藏在生活里，超市里什么卖得好，往往比研报更早告诉你答案。
story.body_en: Peter Lynch noticed something strange at Fidelity. The worse the economy felt, the better lipstick sold. When money is tight, lipstick is the cheapest happiness. Great ideas hide in daily life. He beat the market for thirteen years.

lines.en: Boston, nineteen eighty. The star manager of the Magellan Fund is walking through a department store, not a trading floor.
lines.zh: 波士顿，1980 年。麦哲伦基金的明星经理逛的不是交易厅，是百货商场。

lines.en: Peter, why are you looking at the cosmetics counter? We invest in companies, not makeup.
lines.zh: 彼得，你看化妆品柜台干什么？我们投的是公司，不是口红。

lines.en: Look at the sales data. The worse the economy feels, the better lipstick sells.
lines.zh: 你看看销售数据。经济越差，口红反而卖得越好。

lines.en: That makes no sense. Why would anyone buy lipstick in a recession?
lines.zh: 这不合理啊。经济衰退谁还买口红？

lines.en: When money is tight, she skips the new dress. But a lipstick is the cheapest happiness she can still afford.
lines.zh: 钱紧的时候，新衣服不买了。但口红，是她还买得起的、最便宜的开心。

lines.en: People later called it the lipstick effect. Lynch's real lesson was this. Great ideas hide in daily life, and he beat the market for thirteen years by paying attention.
lines.zh: 后来人们把这叫作口红效应。林奇真正的心得是：机会藏在生活里。他靠这份留心，跑赢市场十三年。

joke.title_zh: 地上有一张十美元，经济学家为什么不捡
joke.title_en: Why Economists Never Pick Up Money
joke.body_zh: 两个经济学家走在街上，看见地上躺着一张十美元。年轻的说，快去捡。老的说，不可能，如果是真的，早就被人捡走了。这是对有效市场理论最经典的调侃：所有信息都已经反映在价格里，天上不会掉馅饼。玩笑归玩笑，它也留了个真实的尾巴——市场大多数时候确实很有效，但偶尔，地上的钱是真的。
joke.body_en: Two economists walk down the street. They spot a ten dollar bill on the ground. The young one says, pick it up. The old one says, it cannot be real. If it were real, someone would have picked it up already. This is the classic joke about efficient markets. All information is already in the price. Free money does not lie on the street. But here is the twist. Markets are efficient most of the time. Only most. Once in a while, the money on the ground is real.

items.title_en: Gold experiences its largest weekly decline since March, pressured by hawkish signals from the Federal Reserve and a sharp drop in AI stocks.

items.title_en: International gold prices hit a new low in over a year. Experts: The underlying reasons are the strengthening of the U.S. dollar and rising expectations of U.S. interest rate hikes.
items.body_en: During the Asian trading session on November 20, London spot gold fell below $3,600/oz, dropping as low as around $3,514 intraday, marking its lowest point in over a year. Domestically, the Shanghai Gold Exchange saw its lowest intraday price dip to RMB 755/g. This nearly year-long rally in gold prices has recently undergone a significant correction. Analysts suggest that the renewed rise in market expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate hikes has been the direct catalyst for this correction. Zhang Zhouchi, a senior analyst at the Caitong Securities Research Institute, believes that gold has been on a downward trend since mid-October. Moreover, it is not just gold; all precious metals have experienced significant declines, with silver showing an even sharper drop.

items.title_zh: 穆迪对英国的评级
items.body_zh: AA3评级平衡了富裕、多元化的经济和强大的机构，以及温和的增长前景和充满挑战的财政前景。 与欧盟更紧密的经济合作以及人工智能带来的生产力提升，为经济增长带来了中期上行风险。 随着通胀放缓，预计债务负担能力将趋于稳定，但利息支出相对于财政收入仍将处于高位。 预计英国财政赤字将在2026年收窄至4.5%，2027年收窄至4%。 到本十年末，英国政府债务将从2025年占GDP的102%升至106%。
items.title_en: Moody's rating of the UK.
items.body_en: The AA3 rating balances a wealthy, diversified economy and strong institutions with a moderate growth outlook and challenging fiscal prospects. Closer economic cooperation with the EU and productivity gains from artificial intelligence present medium-term upside risks to economic growth. As inflation slows, debt sustainability is expected to stabilize, but interest expenditure will remain high relative to fiscal revenue. The UK's fiscal deficit is expected to narrow to 4.5% in 2026 and 4% in 2027. By the end of this decade, U.K. government debt will rise from 102% of GDP in 2025 to 106%.

items.title_en: European stock markets experience their largest weekly decline since 2025, with tech stocks taking a significant hit.
items.body_en: As market doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom resurface, global assets ranging from stocks to copper have been impacted, with European stock markets recording their largest weekly decline since April 2025. The STOXX Europe 600 Index closed down 2%, bringing its cumulative decline for the week to 5.8%. The technology sector index plummeted by 11% this week, marking its largest weekly decline since March 2020. As copper and gold prices fell, mining stocks also declined. Investors have shifted to buying more defensive sectors such as personal care, food, and healthcare.

items.title_en: Report: Retail investor demand for Anthropic's IPO reaches $120 billion, surpassing SpaceX.
items.body_en: According to sources, Anthropic PBC's initial public offering (IPO) attracted approximately $115 billion to $120 billion in subscription demand from retail investors, surpassing the amount subscribed by retail investors when SpaceX went public. The IPO of this cutting-edge AI lab attracted over $500 billion in subscription demand from institutional investors, more than double the amount of institutional subscriptions for SpaceX. Anthropic's IPO was the largest in history, with the company and its seven co-founders raising $935 billion through the IPO, including the over-allotment portion, easily surpassing SpaceX's $862 billion.

story.title_zh: 最自信的一年，他差点赔光一切
story.title_en: The Year of Total Confidence Nearly Ruined Him
story.body_zh: 一九八二年，达利欧公开判断美国经济将走向萧条并重仓押注。结果墨西哥违约后市场不跌反涨，公司只剩他一个人。他从此写下每笔决策的依据，把痛苦变成算法，后来的桥水成了全球最大对冲基金。
story.body_en: In nineteen eighty-two, Ray Dalio predicted a depression, loudly and publicly. Then Mexico defaulted, and markets rose instead of falling. His company shrank to one person: himself. From then on, he logged every decision. Pain became an algorithm. That log built Bridgewater, the largest hedge fund in the world.

lines.en: Nineteen eighty-two. A young trader goes on television, and says the word everyone fears. Depression.
lines.zh: 1982 年。一个年轻交易员上电视，说出了所有人害怕的那个词：萧条。

lines.en: I am completely certain. The economy is going down. I have bet everything on it.
lines.zh: 我非常确定，经济要往下走。我把全部身家都押上了。

lines.en: Then Mexico defaulted. And the market did the one thing he did not expect. It rose.
lines.zh: 然后，墨西哥违约了。市场做了他唯一没料到的事：上涨。

lines.en: Ray, you have to close the company. You have lost everything.
lines.zh: 瑞，你得把公司关了，你什么都赔光了。

lines.en: I have four thousand dollars left, borrowed from my father. And one employee. Me.
lines.zh: 我还剩向我爸借的四千美元，和一个员工——我自己。

lines.en: He later called it the most valuable event of his life. From then on, he wrote down the reason behind every decision. Every mistake was logged and studied. Pain became an algorithm.
lines.zh: 他后来称这次经历是一生中最宝贵的。从那以后，他把每个决策的依据都写下来，每个错误都记录归档。痛苦，变成了算法。

joke.title_zh: 邻居失业叫衰退，自己失业叫萧条
joke.title_en: A Recession Is When Your Neighbor Loses His Job
joke.body_zh: 据说杜鲁门总统这样区分经济术语：邻居失业，叫衰退；自己失业，才叫萧条。一句话戳破了宏大叙事——经济数据再漂亮，落到每个具体的人身上，感受是完全不同的。这也提醒我们读新闻时留个心眼：报表上的百分比，都是别人的人生。理解经济，要从理解一个具体的人开始。
joke.body_en: President Truman supposedly explained economic terms this way. A recession is when your neighbor loses his job. A depression is when you lose yours. One sentence, and all the big words collapse. Growth rates look beautiful on paper. But every percentage point is somebody's real life. It is a good habit when reading the news. Behind every statistic, there is a person. Economics starts with people, not charts.

story.title_zh: 省下一滴焊料的人，成了首富
story.title_en: The Man Who Saved One Drop of Solder
story.body_zh: 洛克菲勒参观自家炼油厂，问工人焊一个油桶用几滴焊料。答：四十滴。他让人试试三十八滴，一滴不漏。就为这两滴，工厂每年省下大笔钱。他说：巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真。
story.body_en: Young Rockefeller once watched workers seal oil barrels. He asked how many drops of solder each barrel took. Forty, they said. He asked them to try thirty-eight. Not a single barrel leaked. His ledgers went to three decimal places. Great wealth comes from great attention to small things.

lines.en: Ohio, eighteen seventy. A quiet man in a dark suit is watching workers seal oil barrels, one by one.
lines.zh: 俄亥俄，1870 年。一个穿黑西装的安静男人，正看着工人们一个一个焊接油桶。

lines.en: How many drops of solder does one barrel take?
lines.zh: 焊一个桶，要用几滴焊料？

lines.en: Forty drops, sir. Same as always.
lines.zh: 四十滴，先生。一直都是四十滴。

lines.en: Try thirty-eight.
lines.zh: 试试三十八滴。

lines.en: They tried. Not a single barrel leaked. Those two drops saved the plant real money, every single year.
lines.zh: 工人们试了。一滴都没漏。就这两滴，每年给工厂省下真金白银。

lines.en: Great wealth comes from great attention to small things. Saved one drop at a time.
lines.zh: 巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真，一滴一滴攒出来的。

joke.title_zh: 银行家为什么辞职？他失去了“利息”
joke.title_en: Why Did the Banker Quit? He Lost Interest
joke.body_zh: 一位年轻银行家在大银行干满一年就辞职了。朋友都问他为什么，他只说了一句：我失去了利息。这个笑话妙在双关。英文里利息和兴趣是同一个词。对银行家来说，这两样东西缺一样都干不下去。所以下次见到闷闷不乐的银行家，你可以关心地问一句：是利息的问题，还是兴趣的问题？
joke.body_en: A young banker worked at a big bank for exactly one year. Then he quit. His friends all asked why. He gave them a one line answer. I lost interest. The joke works in two ways. In English, the money a bank pays you, and the feeling of caring, are the same word. A banker cannot survive without either one. So next time you meet a sad banker, ask politely. Is it the interest, or the interest?

items.title_en: Federal Reserve Meeting Minutes: Two officials stated that a December rate hike exceeding 25 basis points is warranted, and nearly all participants believe that further action may be appropriate.
items.body_en: The Federal Reserve's meeting minutes indicate that almost all participants in the Federal Reserve's October 27–28 meeting believed that further interest rate hikes, largely in line with policymakers' September projections, might be appropriate. Most participants expressed support for not raising interest rates at the October meeting. A few participants noted that if subsequent inflation data were unfavorable, the December meeting could consider raising interest rates by more than 25 basis points. A few participants believed that inflation might be more persistent than expected, making it necessary to shift to a more restrictive policy stance. Some participants supported a 25-basis-point rate hike at the October meeting, emphasizing that inflation was too high and showed almost no signs of easing.

items.title_en: UK bond yields generally fell by about 8 basis points, as traders reduced their bets on the Bank of England's interest rate hike outlook.
items.body_en: At the close of European trading hours on Wednesday (November 18), the yield on the 10-year UK Treasury bond fell by 8.2 basis points to 5.287%. The yield on 2-year UK government bonds fell by 7.9 basis points to 4.913%. The 30-year UK gilt yield fell by 8.2 basis points, and the 50-year UK gilt yield fell by 7.7 basis points. The spread between the 2-year and 10-year UK government bond yields fell by 0.510 basis points, closing at +37.162 basis points.

items.body_en: According to data from the U.S. Treasury Department, in September, the top three foreign holders of U.S. Treasury bonds all reduced their holdings. Nvidia's market leadership and financial position remain exceptionally strong, but a rating upgrade is unlikely over the next 12 to 18 months. Government investigations related to events prior to Jensen Huang's resignation may distract management's attention.

items.title_zh: 科学家利用量子纠缠特性首次完成位置验证
items.body_zh: 美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）等机构研究团队18日在《自然》杂志在线发表研究成果，首次完整演示了一种量子位置验证协议。实验表明，利用量子纠缠等特性，可以确认他是否确实身处该地。这为防止远程身份欺诈提供新思路，不过，要将这项技术投入实际应用可能还需十年以上。（科技日报）
items.title_en: Scientists use quantum entanglement to complete position verification for the first time.
items.body_en: On the 18th, research teams from institutions such as the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) published their findings online in the journal Nature, presenting for the first time a complete demonstration of a quantum location verification protocol. The experiment showed that by utilizing properties such as quantum entanglement, it is possible to confirm whether a person is actually present at a certain location. This provides a new approach to preventing remote identity fraud. However, it may take more than a decade to put this technology into practical use. (Science and Technology Daily).

items.title_zh: 赛诺菲口服药venglustat成为首款获美国批准用于治疗罕见神经系统疾病的药物
items.body_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）周三批准了赛诺菲旗下公司的口服药物文格鲁斯塔特（venglustat），该监管机构表示，这使其成为首款用于治疗一种 影响大脑和神经系统的罕见遗传性疾病的 药物。 该药物商品名为Infilbray ，获批用于治疗第3型戈谢病——这是一种神经系统变异型疾病，会导致某些脂肪物质在器官和组织中积聚。
items.title_en: Sanofi's oral drug venglustat becomes the first drug approved in the United States for the treatment of a rare neurological disorder.
items.body_en: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved venglustat, an oral drug from a Sanofi subsidiary, on Wednesday. The regulatory agency stated that this makes it the first drug to treat a rare genetic disorder that affects the brain and nervous system. The drug, marketed under the name Infilbray, has been approved for the treatment of Gaucher disease type 3, a neurovisceral variant of the disease that causes certain fatty substances to accumulate in organs and tissues.

story.title_zh: 把银行家锁进书房，直到他们答应救市
story.title_en: The Night He Locked the Bankers In
story.body_zh: 一九〇七年十月纽约股市崩盘，没有央行兜底的美国眼看滑向恐慌。六十九岁的摩根把几十位银行总裁锁进书房，逼出两千五百万美元救市资金，凌晨签下协议，恐慌停了。五年后美联储成立。
story.body_en: In October nineteen oh seven, New York was in panic. America had no central bank. J.P. Morgan, sixty-nine years old, summoned bank presidents to his library and locked the doors. The deal was signed after midnight. The panic stopped. Five years later, the Federal Reserve was born.

lines.en: New York, October, nineteen oh seven. Depositors are lining up in the streets. America has no central bank, and the panic is spreading.
lines.zh: 纽约，1907 年 10 月。储户在街头排起长队。美国没有央行，恐慌正在蔓延。

lines.en: So the most powerful banker in America did something nobody would dare today.
lines.zh: 于是，全美最有权势的银行家做了一件今天没人敢做的事。

lines.en: Gentlemen, you will all come to my library tonight. Bring your real numbers, not the ones for newspapers.
lines.zh: 诸位，今晚都到我的书房来。带上真实的账目，别带给报纸看的那份。

lines.en: He questioned each president one by one, behind closed doors, until the true holes were on the table.
lines.zh: 他关门一个个逼问各位总裁，直到真实的窟窿全部摆上桌面。

lines.en: It is almost twelve o'clock. Nobody leaves this room until the papers are signed.
lines.zh: 现在快十二点了。文件不签完，谁也别想出这个门。

lines.en: After midnight, twenty-five million dollars was pledged. The panic stopped. Five years later, partly because of this night, the Federal Reserve was born.
lines.zh: 午夜过后，两千五百万美元的救市资金凑齐了。恐慌停了。五年后，正因为这一夜，美联储诞生了。

joke.title_zh: 杯子半满？工程师说杯子太大了
joke.title_en: Half Full? The Engineer Says the Glass Is Too Big
joke.body_zh: 乐观主义者说杯子是半满的，悲观主义者说是半空的，工程师看了看说：这个杯子比实际需要的大了一倍。放到市场里也一样：同一个行情，多头看到机会，空头看到风险，而真正干活的人只关心一件事——估值和实际价值差多少。别急着站队，先量一量杯子。
joke.body_en: The optimist says the glass is half full. The pessimist says it is half empty. The engineer looks at both and says, the glass is twice as big as it needs to be. Markets work the same way. The bull sees opportunity. The bear sees risk. The person doing the actual work asks only one question. How far is the price from the real value? Do not rush to pick a side. First, measure the glass.

story.title_zh: 一夜之间，与英格兰银行对赌的人
story.title_en: The Night He Bet Against the Bank of England
story.body_zh: 一九九二年，英镑被固定汇率锁在偏高的位置。索罗斯判断英国撑不住。九月十六日英国一天加息两次仍挡不住卖盘，当晚英镑暴跌。他的基金净赚约十亿美元，报纸标题写着打垮了英格兰银行。
story.body_en: In nineteen ninety-two, the British pound was locked into a fixed exchange rate that was too high. On September sixteenth, Britain raised rates twice in one day. It was not enough. That evening, the pound crashed. His fund made about one billion dollars.

lines.en: London, September, nineteen ninety-two. Black Wednesday is only hours away.
lines.zh: 伦敦，1992 年 9 月。距离黑色星期三，只剩几个小时了。

lines.en: George, the Bank of England keeps defending the pound. Rates went up again this morning.
lines.zh: 乔治，英格兰银行还在死守英镑，今天上午又加息了。

lines.en: A weak economy cannot defend an overvalued currency forever. Increase the position.
lines.zh: 疲软的经济，守不住高估的货币。继续加仓。

lines.en: All of it? This is the Bank of England we are betting against.
lines.zh: 全部押上？我们赌的对手可是英格兰银行。

lines.en: When a trade is right, go for the jugular.
lines.zh: 当一笔交易是对的，就要直取要害。

lines.en: That evening Britain gave up, and the pound crashed out of the system. His fund made about one billion dollars. Newspapers said he broke the Bank of England.
lines.zh: 当晚，英国投降了，英镑暴跌退出汇率机制。他的基金净赚约十亿美元。报纸标题写着：他打垮了英格兰银行。

joke.title_zh: 擦鞋童都在荐股的那天，他清仓离场
joke.title_en: When the Shoeshine Boy Gave Stock Tips
joke.body_zh: 一九二九年，约瑟夫·肯尼迪让擦鞋童擦鞋，小孩却热心地给他推荐起股票来。他回到办公室立刻清仓。他的逻辑是：连擦鞋童都在荐股，说明最后一批买家已经进场，接下来只有卖盘了。没过多久，大崩盘来了。这个观察后来被称为擦鞋童理论：当所有人都在谈论某样东西时，往往意味着它已经不便宜了。
joke.body_en: New York, nineteen twenty-nine. Joseph Kennedy got his shoes polished, and the shoeshine boy happily gave him stock tips. Kennedy walked back to his office and sold everything. His logic was sharp. If the shoeshine boy is giving stock tips, the last buyers have already arrived. Who is left to buy? Soon after, the market crashed. People still call it the shoeshine boy theory. When everybody talks about something, it is usually no longer cheap.

items.title_zh: 美联储理事Barr称AI智能体或加大未来银行挤兑风险
items.body_zh: 美联储理事Michael Barr警告称，自主AI智能体可能会根据市场信号或利率变化自动转移客户存款，从而加大银行挤兑风险。Barr周一在米兰举行的一次会议上发表讲话时指出，大型银行已经发现有AI智能体试图在零售账户中执行未经授权的操作。过去客户需要亲自执行转账操作，而现在AI智能体能够立即检测到收益率差异或市场波动信号，并自主高速转移资金，这可能会加速几分钟内发生的挤兑，使传统的流动性管理和监管干预时限难以招架。
items.title_en: Federal Reserve Governor Barr says AI agents could increase the risk of future bank runs.
items.body_en: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr has warned that autonomous AI agents could automatically transfer customer deposits based on market signals or interest rate changes, thereby increasing the risk of bank runs. Speaking at a conference in Milan on Monday, Barr noted that large banks have already detected AI agents attempting to perform unauthorized actions in retail accounts. In the past, customers had to personally execute transfer operations. Now, AI agents can instantly detect yield differentials or signals of market volatility and autonomously transfer funds at high speed. This could accelerate bank runs within minutes, making traditional liquidity management and regulatory intervention timelines difficult to cope with.

story.title_zh: 从每周一美元二毛，到钢铁大王
story.title_en: From a Dollar Twenty a Week to Steel
story.body_zh: 卡内基十三岁移民美国，第一份工每周挣一美元二毛。当电报信童时，他背下全城商户的名字和脸。二十几岁把全部身家压进钢铁，建成世界最大钢铁厂。晚年捐出九成财产。
story.body_en: Andrew Carnegie arrived in America from Scotland at thirteen. His first job paid one dollar and twenty cents a week. As a messenger boy, he memorized every business in town. In his thirties he bet everything on steel, built the largest steel company in the world, then gave away ninety percent of it.

lines.en: Pittsburgh, eighteen fifty. A thirteen year old Scottish immigrant starts his first job. It pays one dollar and twenty cents a week.
lines.zh: 匹兹堡，1850 年。一个十三岁的苏格兰移民开始第一份工作，周薪一美元二毛。

lines.en: Boy, the telegraph office needs a messenger. Can you learn the streets?
lines.zh: 小子，电报局要个信童。你能把街巷记熟吗？

lines.en: I will learn more than the streets, sir. I will learn every business in town, and every face behind the door.
lines.zh: 先生，我记的不只是街巷。我要记住全城每一家商户，和每扇门后面的每张脸。

lines.en: While other boys played, he drilled himself on the telegraph key, and became the fastest ear in the city.
lines.zh: 别的孩子去玩了，他对着电报机日夜苦练，成了全城收发电报最快的人。

lines.en: Save it, invest it early, and when you find your industry, bet everything on it.
lines.zh: 把钱存下来，早一点投出去。找到属于自己的行业时，就把全部身家押上去。

lines.en: He built the largest steel company in the world. Then he gave ninety percent of it away, with one line for the history books. Dying rich is a disgrace.
lines.zh: 他建成了世界最大的钢铁公司，然后捐出了九成财产，只留给历史一句话：带着巨富死去，是一种耻辱。

joke.title_zh: 我是靠卖得太早赚的钱
joke.title_en: I Made My Fortune by Selling Too Early
joke.body_zh: 罗斯柴尔德家族的男爵说过一句反直觉的话：我是靠卖得太早，才赚到钱的。人人都怕卖早了少赚，可他偏偏说卖早是美德。背后的道理是：没人能卖在最高点，总想赚最后一分钱的人，往往连本带利还回去。留给读者一个问题：你手里的盈利，是因为贪心多等了几天，还是因为纪律提前落袋？
joke.body_en: Baron Rothschild said something that sounds backwards. I made my fortune by selling too early. Everyone fears selling too soon and missing the top. He called selling early a virtue. The logic is simple. Nobody sells at the exact peak. People who chase the last penny usually return everything, and more. So here is a question worth thinking about. Your last winning trade. Did you hold longer out of greed, or exit early out of discipline?
